General Knowledge 2012-II.subject: General Knowledge
General Knowledge 2012-II.question: In the parlance of financial investment, the term bear denotes
options: an investor, who feels that the price of a particular security is going to fall
an investor, who expects the price of a particular share to rise
a shareholder, who has an interest in a company, financially or otherwise
any lender, whether by making a loan or buying a bond
General Knowledge 2012-II.answer: an investor, who feels that the price of a particular security is going to fall

General Knowledge 2012-II.subject: General Knowledge
General Knowledge 2012-II.question: Which one among the following is an appropriate description of deflation?
options: it is a sudden fall in the value of a currency against other currencies
It is a persistent recession in the economy
It is a persistent fall in the general price level of goods and services
It is fall in the rate of inflation over a period of time
General Knowledge 2012-II.answer: it is a sudden fall in the value of a currency against other currencies
